# 2 Chronicles Chapter 33 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Son-of twelve years was-Manasseh in-his-reigning and-fifty-and-five years he-reigned in-Jerusalem.

**2** And-he-did the-evil in-eyes-of YHWH according-to-abominations-of the-nations that dispossessed YHWH from-before sons-of Israel.

**3** And-he-returned and-he-built the-high-places that tore-down Hezekiah his-father and-he-raised altars for-the-Baals and-he-made Asherim and-he-worshiped to-all host-of the-heavens and-he-served-them.

**4** And-he-built altars in-house-of YHWH that said YHWH in-Jerusalem shall-be My-name forever.

**5** And-he-built altars for-all host-of the-heavens in-two courts-of house-of YHWH.

**6** And-he he-passed his-sons through-the-fire in-valley-of son-of Hinnom and-he-practiced-soothsaying and-divination and-sorcery and-he-made a-medium and-a-necromancer he-multiplied to-do the-evil in-eyes-of YHWH to-provoke-Him.

**7** And-he-put image-of the-idol that he-made in-house-of God that said God to-David and-to-Solomon his-son in-this house and-in-Jerusalem that I-chose from-all tribes-of Israel I-will-put My-name forever.

**8** And-not I-will-add to-remove foot-of Israel from-upon the-land that I-established for-your-fathers only if they-keep to-do all that I-commanded-them to-all the-law and-the-statutes and-the-judgments by-hand-of Moses.

**9** And-he-led-astray Manasseh Judah and-inhabitants-of Jerusalem to-do evil more-than the-nations that destroyed YHWH from-before sons-of Israel.

**10** And-He-spoke YHWH to Manasseh and-to his-people and-not they-listened.

**11** And-He-brought YHWH upon-them commanders-of army that were-for-king-of Assyria and-they-captured Manasseh with-the-hooks and-they-bound-him with-the-bronze-chains and-they-brought-him to-Babylon.

**12** And-as-he-was-in-distress he-entreated the-face-of YHWH his-God and-he-humbled-himself greatly before God-of his-fathers.

**13** And-he-prayed to-Him and-He-was-entreated by-him and-He-heard his-plea and-He-returned-him to-Jerusalem to-his-kingdom and-he-knew Manasseh that YHWH He is-God.

**14** And-after this he-built a-wall outer to-city-of David to-west to-Gihon in-the-valley and-to-entering gate-of the-fish and-he-surrounded the-Ophel and-he-raised-it very-much and-he-put commanders-of force in-all cities-of Judah the-fortified.

**15** And-he-removed gods-of the-foreign and-the-idol from-house-of YHWH and-all the-altars that he-built in-mountain-of house-of YHWH and-in-Jerusalem and-he-cast to-outside the-city.

**16** And-he-built altar-of YHWH and-he-sacrificed upon-it sacrifices-of peace-offerings and-thank-offerings and-he-said to-Judah to-serve YHWH God-of Israel.

**17** Nevertheless still the-people were-sacrificing on-the-high-places only to-YHWH their-God.

**18** And-rest-of acts-of Manasseh and-his-prayer to his-God and-words-of the-seers the-speaking to-him in-name-of YHWH God-of Israel behold-them on acts-of kings-of Israel.

**19** And-his-prayer and-being-entreated to-him and-all his-sin and-his-unfaithfulness and-the-places that he-built in-them high-places and-he-set the-Asherim and-the-images before his-humbling behold-them written on words-of Hozai.

**20** And-he-lay-down Manasseh with his-fathers and-they-buried-him in-his-house and-he-reigned Amon his-son in-his-place.

**21** Son-of twenty-and-two years was-Amon in-his-reigning and-two years he-reigned in-Jerusalem.

**22** And-he-did the-evil in-eyes-of YHWH as-did Manasseh his-father and-to-all the-images that made Manasseh his-father sacrificed Amon and-he-served-them.

**23** And-not he-humbled-himself before YHWH as-humbled-himself Manasseh his-father for he Amon multiplied guilt.

**24** And-they-conspired against-him his-servants and-they-killed-him in-his-house.

**25** And-they-struck people-of the-land all the-conspirators against the-king Amon and-they-made-king people-of the-land Josiah his-son in-his-place.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **33:11-13**: they-captured Manasseh...He-returned-him to-Jerusalem — Manasseh's captivity, repentance, and restoration is unique to Chronicles (absent from Kings). It is the most dramatic application of 7:14 in the entire book.

- **33:13**: he-knew Manasseh that YHWH He is-God — Recognition of YHWH through suffering. The worst king learns what the best kings proclaim.

- **33:23**: not he-humbled-himself...as-humbled-himself Manasseh — The contrast with his father exposes Amon's failure: he inherited Manasseh's sins but not his repentance.


— EMET
